senses.gloss:
Ante-vāsin, ‘dwelling near,’ is the epithet of the Brahma-
cārin who lives in the house of his teacher. The expression
does not occur before the late Brāhmaṇa period.^1 Secrecy is
often enjoined on others than Antevāsins.^2
1) Satapatha Brāhmaṇa, v. 1, 5, 17;
Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad, vi. 3, 7;
Chāndogya Upaniṣad, iii. 11, 5; iv.
10, 1; Taittirīya Upaniṣad, i. 3, 3;
11, 1.
2) Aitareya Āraṇyaka, iii. 2, 6; Sāṅkh-
āyana Āraṇyaka, viii, 11.
